svg.text: Calibrating Entrepreneurial Evidence to the Cost of Being Wrong
How much evidence should an entrepreneur require
before acting on a particular assumption?
Excessive testing can also destroy option value.
What action is actually being considered?
What must be true for this action to work?
What could verify or refute it?
A falsifiable claim and evidence record
How difficult is a mistake to unwind?
Can assets and resources be reused?
What proof is proportionate to the exposure?
What must be observed before acting?
Cost and delay of further testing
What signal activates revision or exit?
Fees, duties, people and third parties
FIVE-DIMENSIONAL ASSESSMENT • SEPARATE FROM THE FIVE CANVAS STEPS
Proceed with monitoring / Test smaller / Renegotiate commitment / Defer
Exit signal and review loop return the decision to Stage 01
Decision-specific research artefact • Olive & Oat VI • Candidate index not empirically calibrated
